label: Stop now
plainEnglishMeaning: End vehicle use because an immediate risk may be present.
whenToUse: Critical control, fire, heat, leak, or warning conditions
customerFacingRecommendation: Stop in the nearest safe place and seek qualified help.
safetyBoundaries: Do not resume use based only on remote guidance.
nextInfoNeeded: Current location; active hazards; occupants safe

label: Arrange a tow
plainEnglishMeaning: Move the vehicle without driving it.
whenToUse: Driving may worsen risk or the vehicle cannot move reliably
customerFacingRecommendation: Arrange towing to a suitable inspection or repair location.

label: Move only to a safer place
plainEnglishMeaning: Allow the shortest limited movement only when immediate control remains normal.
whenToUse: A low-speed move may reduce exposure to roadside danger
customerFacingRecommendation: Move only to the nearest safe place and stop if symptoms change.
safetyBoundaries: Never frame this as normal driving clearance.
nextInfoNeeded: Brakes; steering; warning lights; distance to safety

label: Basic safe check
plainEnglishMeaning: Gather observations that do not require driving, heat exposure, or disassembly.
whenToUse: A parked visual check may clarify the next step
customerFacingRecommendation: Check only what is visible and safe; skip anything uncertain.
safetyBoundaries: No crawling under, hot-system opening, or electrical contact.
nextInfoNeeded: Dashboard; visible tires; visible leak; current status

label: Request more information
plainEnglishMeaning: Pause the conclusion until specific evidence is available.
customerFacingRecommendation: Send the requested details if already available or safely obtainable.
safetyBoundaries: Missing evidence must not be treated as evidence of safety.

label: Monitor with boundaries
plainEnglishMeaning: Observe a lower-risk issue for defined changes.
whenToUse: Current evidence suggests lower urgency without safety clearance
customerFacingRecommendation: Track changes and schedule help if warning signs appear.
safetyBoundaries: Not for control, fire, severe leak, overheating, or red-warning cases.

label: Schedule inspection
plainEnglishMeaning: Obtain a physical evaluation before relying on a remote conclusion.
whenToUse: Physical testing is needed to narrow the cause
safetyBoundaries: Do not imply certification before inspection.

label: Professional repair
plainEnglishMeaning: Use a qualified provider for diagnosis and repair.
whenToUse: Risk, complexity, tools, or testing exceed a basic owner check
customerFacingRecommendation: Use the evidence packet to request verification before parts approval.
safetyBoundaries: No guaranteed repair outcome or price.
nextInfoNeeded: Written estimate; verified cause; repair scope

label: DIY may be possible
plainEnglishMeaning: A limited owner task may be considered only within competence and safe conditions.
whenToUse: Low-risk task with clear boundaries and no safety-system uncertainty
customerFacingRecommendation: Consider only a basic task you already know how to perform safely.
nextInfoNeeded: Skill; tools; service information; risk screening

label: Complete repair required
plainEnglishMeaning: A temporary measure is not an adequate final resolution.
whenToUse: Normal use should wait for verified repair
customerFacingRecommendation: Complete and verify the necessary repair before normal use.
safetyBoundaries: Temporary improvement is not proof of safety.

label: Sell as-is
plainEnglishMeaning: Disclose known issues and sell without claiming repair or certification.
whenToUse: Repair is not preferred or economical
customerFacingRecommendation: Use clear factual disclosures and supporting evidence.
safetyBoundaries: Seller remains responsible for title, legal, and disclosure compliance.
nextInfoNeeded: Title status; known issues; evidence; local requirements

label: Buyer requests more evidence
plainEnglishMeaning: Ask the seller for missing records or condition evidence.
customerFacingRecommendation: Request specific evidence before spending more time or money.
nextInfoNeeded: VIN; title; cold start; codes; records

label: Buyer walks away
plainEnglishMeaning: End pursuit when risk or missing cooperation is unacceptable.
whenToUse: Red flags, contradictions, or blocked inspection exceed tolerance
customerFacingRecommendation: Do not proceed unless the material concern is independently resolved.

label: Proceed to in-person inspection
plainEnglishMeaning: Advance only to independent physical review, not purchase.
whenToUse: Remote evidence supports further evaluation but not a buying decision
customerFacingRecommendation: Arrange an independent inspection before commitment.
safetyBoundaries: No purchase or safety clearance is implied.

label: Human review required
plainEnglishMeaning: Hold customer delivery for qualified review.
whenToUse: High-risk, title, structural, high-cost, or low-confidence case
customerFacingRecommendation: A human reviewer must approve the next-step language.
nextInfoNeeded: Risk flags; draft; evidence; open questions

label: Do not send
plainEnglishMeaning: Block customer delivery of an unsafe or unsuitable draft.
whenToUse: Content fails safety, quality, consent, or workflow rules
customerFacingRecommendation: Keep the draft internal until corrected or closed.
